The '''Lake Octir Swamp''' was a swamp that surrounded the [[Lake Octir]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It bordered the [[Narmle Bog]], the [[Madyn Plains]], the [[Narlis Fens]] and the [[Narmle Swamp]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Lake Octir Swamp is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
